tbesh_html:
1) resting place, rest
1a) resting place
1b) rest, quietness
Also means: nu.ach (נוּחַ "rest" H5118)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: repose or (adverbially) peacefully; figuratively, consolation (specifically, matrimony); hence (concretely) an abode
strongs_1890.kjv_def: comfortable, ease, quiet, rest(-ing place), still.
